subject: Bosses in FPS
author: Xandu
body:
Well pretty much all of the classic first person shooters had bosses. Doom, Duke, Caslte Wolfenstein, Quake, Hexic, Hexen, Wicthhaven, blood... yeah pretty much all games based on the build engine and many more.

Of newer FPS games Prey had bosses...

Im sure Duke Nukem 4ever will have bosses when/if it comes out. 😃

If we have a look at strategic FPS games that is a total different story.

-- The Creator --
